name: dsh-reel
description: Browse images and videos from any directory over the dsh web port: a browse/gallery mode and a vertical swipe feed, with a range-streaming video player.
comment: Deliberately dependency-free: the host half imports only Node built-ins, and the browser half is plain files served as-is. Installing this into a dsh profile adds one Loader row and nothing to the dependency graph, and there is no build step anywhere.
